title: Riso Lane PLATFORM — CI tools, shared quality/testing, sample answers

questions.prompt: What should this PLATFORM goal package primarily enable?
questions.description: PLATFORM is Wave 2 in the multi-agent model: integrates COORD contracts + payload lanes via CI scripts, quality/testing fragments, and sample answers. It does not implement language features.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Standing PLATFORM operating protocol: consume COORD outbox + lane handoffs, update sample answers/CI glue/quality-testing payload only in exclusive roots, regenerate via scripts when intended, hand off payload bugs — no fixed feature backlog baked into the package.

options.label: Standing protocol only
options.description: Define how PLATFORM integrates and verifies; no concrete CI/sample batch locked into the goal.

options.label: Protocol + known backlog
options.description: Same protocol, plus list first concrete PLATFORM work items for the first /goal run.

options.label: Concrete backlog only
options.description: Skip process docs; goal is only a specific set of CI/sample/quality changes.

questions.prompt: What inbound signals should trigger PLATFORM work?
questions.description: PLATFORM integrates other lanes. Choose which durable inputs count as “do work now” vs ignore.
questions.recommendedAnswer: COORD outbox contract deltas (keys/defaults/illegal combos); payload-lane handoffs that affect answers, quality/testing, or CI entrypoints; maintainer CI failures owned by scripts/ci or quality/testing templates. Chat-only notes only if human explicitly promotes them.

options.label: COORD outbox contract deltas
options.description: goals/riso-lane-coord/outbox/* listing changed keys/catalog/context.

options.label: Payload-lane handoffs into PLATFORM inbox
options.description: e.g. goals/riso-lane-platform/inbox/ from PY/NODE/SAAS/SYS/DESKTOP/CLI.

options.label: CI failures in PLATFORM write roots
options.description: Broken scripts/ci, quality/, testing/, sample answers validation.

options.label: Any red CI job (including payload trees)
options.description: PLATFORM may dig into language trees (risks ownership violations).

options.label: Chat/PR freeform only
options.description: No durable inbox; higher multi-agent drift.

questions.prompt: After COORD changes Copier keys, how should PLATFORM update samples/*/copier-answers.yml?
questions.description: Do not invent keys. ~26 sample variants exist. Full matrix regen is separate from answer-file edits.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Update every sample answers file that is missing, extra, or wrong for keys listed in the COORD outbox; run uv run riso validate --answers-file … --json per touched variant. Do not invent defaults beyond COORD defaults/outbox guidance.

options.label: All variants affected by the outbox keys
options.description: Scan samples/*/copier-answers.yml; fix every file impacted by the contract delta.

options.label: Matrix-core variants only
options.description: Only default, api-python, full-stack, saas-starter, and other CI-matrix primaries.

options.label: Only variants named in the handoff
options.description: No automatic scan; human/COORD lists paths.

questions.prompt: When may PLATFORM regenerate samples or edit maintainer workflows?
questions.description: Never hand-edit samples/*/render/. Workflow ownership is allowed only for quality/validate-samples/matrix orchestration and must stay minimal.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Regenerate only when the human asks or when a PLATFORM-owned gate is unprovable without render smoke; prefer single-variant ./scripts/render-samples.sh before full render_matrix.py. Edit .github/workflows/** only if a script entrypoint change cannot land without orchestration glue — keep diffs minimal; prefer scripts/ci changes alone.

options.label: Conservative regen + rare workflow glue
options.description: Human-ask or unprovable gate → narrow regen; workflows only when scripts alone cannot orchestrate.

options.label: Auto full matrix after answer changes
options.description: Always run render_matrix.py when answers change (heavy, slower waves).

options.label: Never regenerate in this lane
options.description: PLATFORM only edits answers/scripts; Wave 3 integrator always regenerates.

questions.prompt: If CI fails because of a language/module payload bug (not PLATFORM-owned), what should PLATFORM do?
questions.description: Forbidden: implement FastAPI/SaaS/Go/Rust/desktop features under language trees. Must file a handoff to PY/NODE/SAAS/SYS/DESKTOP.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Do not edit foreign trees. Write a durable handoff under goals/riso-lane-platform/outbox/ (or the owning lane’s inbox/) with failing command, stack/log excerpt (no secrets), suspected path ownership, and requested fix. Stop PLATFORM work on that failure path until the owning lane returns.

options.label: Durable outbox/inbox handoff file
options.description: goals/riso-lane-platform/outbox/<id>.md (or per-lane inbox).

options.label: GitHub issue only
options.description: Open issue via gh; no goals/ file (weaker offline multi-agent continuity).

options.label: Chat note only
options.description: Summarize in session; no durable artifact.

questions.prompt: What is the default verification bar for a PLATFORM change set?
questions.description: Existing tools: verify_context_sync, validate_agents_ecosystem, render_matrix, render-samples, riso validate, tests/unit/ci/, just quality.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Always: uv run riso validate --json on every touched answers file; uv run pytest on tests/unit/ci/ (or narrower tests) when scripts/ci change; just quality when maintainer Python CI scripts change broadly. Conditional: verify_context_sync when context runners involved; validate_agents_ecosystem when agents gates touched; regenerate only under the regen policy above. Never claim success with hand-edited samples/*/render/.

options.label: riso validate on every touched answers file
just quality when CI scripts change broadly
verify_context_sync / validate_agents_ecosystem when those surfaces are involved

questions.prompt: On the first /goal run for this package, what should the agent actually do?
questions.description: Prefer durable bootstrap without inventing product features or unsolicited matrix regen.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Bootstrap PLATFORM artifacts only: inbox/outbox handoff templates, operating checklist (ownership + forbidden paths + verification matrix), dry-run of key entrypoints (riso validate on one sample, pytest tests/unit/ci/ smoke or --collect-only if slow) — no unsolicited answer churn, workflow edits, or full matrix unless an inbox handoff already requires it.

options.label: Bootstrap handoff templates + dry-run verify
options.description: No sample/CI churn unless inbox already has work.

options.label: Audit current PLATFORM surfaces for drift
options.description: Scan answers vs copier keys, quality/testing consistency, and CI unit coverage gaps; fix only proven PLATFORM-owned bugs.

options.label: No files until a real handoff arrives
options.description: Goal package is documentation only; first apply waits for COORD/payload signals.
